messages:
Alex: 🎉 Quick heads-up — we just hit 2x our monthly usage baseline overnight (peak requests/day: 2,012,431). Absolute wild. Huge congrats everyone! :tada:
Rachael: omg yes!!! :confetti_ball: who's bringing treats?
Sanjeev: I can grab cinnamon rolls from Bluebird at 9:50. Also checked infra briefly — 95th latency stayed stable, autoscaler did its thing.
Molly: I'll bring a big thermos of coffee. Can someone make a tiny banner for the kitchen? '2x & thriving' maybe.
DevRel Jen: Love it. I'm drafting a 2-paragraph blurb + a GIF for social. Can I quote folks on what made this possible?
Ops Bot: ops-bot: Autoscaler triggered 3 times during the spike, one fallback to warm-capacity pool. No errors > 5xx.
Alex: Quote away — feel free to highlight batching/kv-cache improvements. Also planning a quick in-office gong at 10:15 (zoom link for remote: https://zoom.fake/party).
Rachael: I'll do gong duty :drum: remote team, drop your party GIFs!
Sanjeev: Filing a tiny "what happened" note for eng-sre so we capture learnings. No pager, just ops notes.
Molly: Poll: donuts or bagels? :doughnut: :bagel: (I vote donuts)
DevRel Jen: Donuts + tiny confetti poppers (work-safe) sound ideal. I'll bring name stickers for anyone who wants one.
Ops Bot: deploy-bot: status banner posted to status.redwood: 'We scaled — thanks team!'
Sanjeev: quick infra Q — saw a couple of 429s around 03:12; retries succeeded. I'll surface the client IDs in the notes.
Alex: Yep tiny client-side backoff needed for a couple customers. We'll reach out proactively. For now, celebrate. :confetti_ball:
Rachael: Pics incoming. Remote folks, send GIFs and I'll compile a small photo slide.
Molly: See you in 20. Proud of everyone! :heart:
DevRel Jen: I'll share the social draft in #marketing in 10 and tag y'all.
Alex: Thank you team — small win, huge momentum. Cake or donuts for next milestone? :thinking_face:
